summary: New box Preterit Intransitive: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (96/35)

data.turoyo: Əmmo: "Ya ahunayḏi! Aṯina li dukṯo pisaṯi, am maye pisinani w, aḥuno, mu taʕbo m balangaziye gawi xašən."
data.translation: Ach Bruder, wir sind an diesen schmutzigen Ort gekommen, zu diesem schmutzigen Wasser, und, Bruder, von der Anstrengung, von der großen Armut ist mein Bauch dick geworden. -

rationale: New Preterit Intransitive box; overt body-part subject and causal context, bare xašən.

summary: New box Preterit Intransitive: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (PrS 22/3)

data.turoyo: Maḥatlala ḥayye bi šarbo l aṯte du aḥuno, šətyola li kačke. Naḥito l gawa, i kačke xašino, nfiḥ gawa.
data.translation: Einmal tat ihr die Frau ihres Bruders eine Schlange in den Wasserkrug; das Mädchen trank die Schlange hinunter und in Folge dessen schwoll ihr Bauch auf.

rationale: Independent feminine example of proposed Preterit Intransitive box, with swelling sequence.

data.turoyo: Qayṣ d məḥalla, kxušno, lə qadiri aʕla. Dwəṣla ġalabe mi ʕaskar.
data.translation: Je mehr Hiebe sie trafen, um so dicker ward sie. Sie vermochten nichts gegen sie; sie aber biss viele der Soldaten,

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; overt k- and magical animal thickening, same inherited sense.

summary: All five occurrences checked. New Preterit Intransitive box is supported provisionally by masculine xašən and feminine xašino/xəšno, while kxušno and prohibitive xəšnət remain Infectum.
The listed xšəlle base has an l-series shape; this run preserves it and records the qaṭəl-shaped finite candidates without inventing a fully established alternate paradigm.
The Arabic etymology is inherited, not newly proven by these texts. They do show stem-I inflection in body-state predicates.
No light-verb construction, idiom or separate new sense is supported.
Confirm that xašən, xašino and xəšno are finite Preterit Intransitive forms rather than adjectival predicates; if both paradigms occur, establish their relationship to listed xšəlle.
Check the lexical adjective shape against xašuno and the reduced feminine vowels using edition/audio; do not silently normalize them.
Animal growth and localized belly enlargement retain become thick; neither magic nor a swollen body part warrants a new numbered sense.
